name: The Peninsula Beverly Hills
positioning: Garden-set hotel in the heart of Beverly Hills, steps from Rodeo Drive, with a rooftop pool, restaurant and spa
best_for: Shoppers who want to be near Rodeo Drive
Families wanting villa suites with separate living areas

facts.text: The hotel is set among tropical gardens in the heart of Beverly Hills.
The hotel is just steps from the Golden Triangle and Rodeo Drive.
The complimentary house car drives guests within Beverly Hills and Century City in a classic Rolls-Royce or another luxury vehicle.
Conde Nast Traveler describes it as a classic French chateau-style hotel.
Deluxe Rooms have French doors opening to views of the gardens, fountain or Beverly Hills skyline.
Patio Deluxe Rooms have a private garden patio with outdoor furniture.
The Roof Garden restaurant's menu is rooted in seasonal, locally sourced ingredients.
The rooftop pool and hot tub look out over the Los Angeles and Century City skyline.
The spa has seven treatment rooms, a private nail suite, a spa cabana and a serenity lounge with city views.
The spa uses products from Biologique Recherche and Medical Beauty Research.
The Hair Atelier, owned by hair stylist David Pierre, offers haircuts, styling, blowouts and hair and scalp treatments.
The fitness center has Woodway treadmills and Peloton bikes, and its locker rooms include Himalayan salt saunas.

highlights.text: The hotel has its own on-site Airport Concierge team at LAX that meets guests at baggage claim for domestic flights and escorts them to a hotel car.
Ground-floor Villa Suites have an outdoor patio with a hot tub.
The two-story Peninsula Villa has hand-painted Chinoiserie panels.
The Roof Garden's signature Green Juice blends cold-pressed apple, cucumber, spinach, celery, parsley, ginger, kale and lemon.
Regular guests get monogrammed pillows, and so do their dogs.

considerations.text: Guests must be 18 or older to use the spa.
The hotel is 11.47 miles from Los Angeles International Airport.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing and a formal atmosphere that may not suit casual travelers.
